scripts.env:check: varlock load --format json > /dev/null && varlock load --path web/ --format json > /dev/null
scripts.env:types: git diff --quiet -- src/env.d.ts web/env.d.ts || (echo "src/env.d.ts or web/env.d.ts changed when regenerated from .env.schema: review and stage them" >&2 && git diff --stat -- src/env.d.ts web/env.d.ts >&2 && exit 1)
scripts.check: pnpm env:check && pnpm env:types && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm test && pnpm --filter web check
scripts.sandbox:build: docker build -t effect-pi/sandbox-shell -f docker/sandbox/shell.Dockerfile docker/sandbox && docker build -t effect-pi/sandbox-desktop -f docker/sandbox/desktop.Dockerfile docker/sandbox
scripts.langfuse:up: node docker/langfuse/init-env.ts && docker compose -f docker/langfuse/docker-compose.yml -p langfuse up -d
scripts.seaweed:up: node docker/seaweedfs/init-env.ts && docker compose -f docker/seaweedfs/docker-compose.yml -p seaweedfs up -d
scripts.litestream:up: node docker/litestream/init-bucket.ts && docker compose -f docker/litestream/docker-compose.yml -p litestream up -d
